artifacts_to_persist: Metadata-only source/split/tokenizer summary and claim boundaries
controls: Verify source DB SHA256 before and after a read-only query.
Three source-native text fields only; strict SQL read-column whitelist.
No source split migration, threshold tuning, padding, duplication or scope substitution.
counting: Pinned tokenizers0.23.2 native Tokenizer.encode(add_special_tokens=False), with truncation/padding explicitly disabled. Counts measure substantive document text alone, not question/option/framework overhead or a working deployment window. English tokenizer also matches the typed-decisions tokenizer bytes.
failure_branches: Missing or altered source/tokenizer/helper pins: fail closed and preserve incomplete artifacts.
Insufficient natural8192/16384 input counts: retain all results and preregister another lawful natural source; do not replace it with padded or synthetic documents.
Enough long documents: still require source-native workflow/metric freeze, label/evidence validity, DEV-only precision/power and evidence-position checks before any quality final.
hypothesis: Verified natural QASPER substantive input documents may provide an8192-token/16384-token source stratum under the pinned current competitor tokenizers; counts are unknown before execution.
input_projection: Read only papers.paper_id, source_partition, group_id, model_state_json and source_groups.group_id, component_id, final_split. SQLite authorizer rejects every other payload column. No questions, answers, annotation values, worker IDs, or evidence targets accessed.
primary_metric: Per-tokenizer and per-split paper/component counts with substantive length>=8192.

promotion_gates.source_census: All1585 projected papers present and original split counts/database bytes unchanged, with no forbidden payload reads or model execution.

scope: Input-only source-length census, not capability, quality, evidence-position, runtime-performance or inferential sample-independence evidence.
secondary_metrics: Complete per-paper source IDs, text/state hashes, token counts and realized split membership.
seed: No random selection; every verified paper projected in deterministic split/group/paper order.
serialization: Reuse existing _document_text on the title/abstract/full_text-only model-state projection. Join original title, abstract, section names and paragraphs with newline. Preserve source wording/order; no NFKC serving normalization, padding, concatenation, clipping or model summary. Figure captions are outside this declared model-state projection and excluded.
splits_and_grouping: Preserve all existing1585 papers/components and train/dev/calibration/confirmation assignments. Threshold eligibility is an input-defined diagnostic stratum, never a model-outcome exclusion. Report every split and all papers, per-paper IDs/hashes/counts privately; no answer labels opened or final scored.
statistical_test: Deterministic census; no population-quality test. Connected components do not establish author/template/statistical independence.
